description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Filter::NumberSuffix' which implements a template filter to display numbers with their three most significant digits and appropriate suffixes (K, M). It includes methods for initialization and filtering numeric values, handling German number formats, and integrating with other modules for significant digit formatting.

classes.name: Coocook::Filter::NumberSuffix
classes.description: Perl package implementing a template filter for formatting numbers with suffixes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter by installing 'number_suffix' filter.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Formats a number to include a suffix (K, M) after converting it to a significant digit representation, handling German number formats and numeric validation.
